section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study comparing body image among Zimbabwean women in Zimbabwe versus Zimbabwean migrants in Britain. The study found that migrants had more negative body image and greater weight discrepancy than non-migrants, with the BAS (Body Appreciation Scale) showing a single dominant factor rather than multiple dimensions. Greater exposure to Western media was associated with lower body appreciation across both samples, while length of residence in Britain did not significantly affect body image measures.
